_schema: Normalized 2025 Donruss per-card records, one entry per real supplied checklist row. Every field is populated FROM the source - never inferred, never guessed. Empty until a real source1 file is supplied to data/football/2025/_staging/donruss-source1-raw.md.

_fields.identityKey: string - '<product>|<setName-or-category>|<cardNumber>' e.g. 'donruss25|Rated Rookies|301'. Card number + product + subset ONLY - player is deliberately excluded from the identity key per instruction, so a genuine duplicate card number within the same subset is caught as a data problem rather than silently disambiguated by player name.
_fields.setName: string - the subset/category name from the raw source, e.g. 'Rated Rookies' (also stored as 'category' for symmetry with the existing 2024 normalizer output shape)
_fields.category: string - same as setName, kept for compatibility with scanProductForPlayer()'s existing rec.category field name
_fields.cardNumber: string|number - exactly as given by the source, not renumbered
_fields.player: string - exactly as given by the source
_fields.team: string - exactly as given by the source, empty string if the source doesn't provide it (never guessed from the player's other-year team)
_fields.rookie: boolean - only true if the source itself marks this record as a rookie card; never inferred from card-number range alone
_fields.source1: string - name/URL of the first source this row came from
_fields.source2: string|null - name/URL of a second, independently-confirming source, once one exists
_fields.verificationStatus: ONE_SOURCE_VERIFIED | TWO_SOURCE_VERIFIED | SOURCE_CONFLICT | INDEPENDENCE_UNCONFIRMED | NOT_READY - see data/checklists/football/2025/donruss-proposed-manifest-entry.md for the full vocabulary and the rules that move a row between these
_fields.rawRecord: object - the original as-supplied row, preserved verbatim for auditability (so a later re-check can compare against exactly what was ingested, not a reconstruction)

_status: EMPTY - no real source1 data has been supplied yet. Do not populate with fabricated rows.
